purpose: Diagnose entry selection and closure maturity in feedback labels using the same independently simulated opportunity library, before proposing another account policy.
population: All 8155 original frozen undercut-reclaim Top5 formations, two registered exits each; no reranking or replacement.
source: Exact online-feedback-entry-v1 parent plan, source snapshots, calendars, environment rows, original schedules and baseline disposition records.

pathContract.execution: Each formation is a separate one-signal, one-security simulation using the unchanged FixedSignalAccount or VolatilityTrailAccount. Preserve all original security fields and bars, full source calendar, original period start/end, fees, slippage, lot, participation and opening gates.
pathContract.prefix: Process all original period sessions before formation. Do not reset history, quarantine or eligibility by shortening the start date.
pathContract.entry: Original Tclose signal and quantity reservation; one attempt at the next source session open; partial remainder expires; no retry, add or backfill.
pathContract.exit: Unchanged trail10 or volatilityTrail, including close-time signals, next-session execution, deferred and partial sells, and inherited reference conversion.
pathContract.earlyTermination: Allowed only after the signal is terminal, there is no position and no unsettled rights, cash receivable/payable, or forced exit. Otherwise process the original cutoff. No future empty sessions affect this label; report the actual last processed date.
pathContract.closedLabel: Fully closed episode net cash PnL divided by initial investedAmount including entry fees; all partial proceeds and charges included. Label matures on final exit date.
pathContract.openOrUnfilled: Open episodes carry unknown final exit and net return, never zero labels. Record terminal mark, realized partial PnL and unfilled entry reasons separately.
pathContract.notPortfolio: Overlapping independent paths are labels, not one investable combined portfolio. Do not aggregate hypothetical profits as an account return. Record path executions separately from new candidate-account trials.

comparisons.main: Within the SAME independent path library compare allExecutable with originalEntered, the latter selected solely by original baseline filledQuantity>0 for that exit.
comparisons.bridge: Reconcile old actual baseline labels with the corresponding independent-path subset; differences include changing original account capital, lots, fees, execution capacity and resulting exit timing. This bridge is separate from membership selection.
comparisons.feedback: Reuse unchanged research_online_feedback implementation: A=T-1, 126 source-calendar slots by final exit date, 20 eligible formation days, each formation day total weight one, same three features and lambda=1. Open/future labels are unavailable.
comparisons.epochs: Full periods 2022-2023 and 2024-2025, each year, and descriptive 2024-09-24 boundary in the latter. No model feature or entry switch uses this date.
comparisons.dependence: Repeated formations and overlapping paths remain dependent; larger row counts are not independent sample counts. Report formation-day and symbol coverage, immature counts and ages, and the still-unresolved maturity selection.
comparisons.promotion: Diagnostic only. No profit, payoff, win-rate or duration threshold is introduced; no new strategy selected from these outcomes.

validation: Meaningful synthetic equivalence and boundary tests before historical execution; validate source identities, every path label and fills, and independent readout reconciliation. Additional direct unchanged-engine full-period reference paths: per period/board/exit choose original-order first and last, plus first closed, unfilled, open and partial path; deduplicate, at most six, never rank by profit. Full-population independent arithmetic and risk checks are distinct from this bounded equivalence sample.
historicalScope: 2022-2025 repeatedly viewed development; 2026 excluded. Frozen survivors and available raw price/rights evidence retain inherited qualifications.
